::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Febry 1st [1864]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 18[^1]
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd),

I enclose what [Mrs Blackburn](people/person_159.qmd) says in answer to my question about the drawings for the [Little Duke](cmy_books/cmybook_20.qmd) - Will you tell me what you think of the matter? I suppose she might improve some of the faces, but I think it is quite open to you to find some other designer. I shall send tomorrow another parcel of [the Trial](cmy_books/cmybook_53.qmd)

Yours faithfully
C.M. Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
